source.new_generator: independently salted layered graph builder (not old source constructor); only public raw16 src bits can be integer or null, never a hidden label field
source.resolvable_mask: one true NULL on another lane of causal target event while an observed differing bit remains, under explicitly frozen exactly-one-error-per-event assumption
source.ambiguous_mask: two unknown lanes at final event: one matching first anchor and another different; two latent one-bit completions with opposite causal validity produce byte-for-byte identical PUBLIC graph
source.public_equality: ambiguity has two opposite latent-world labels on the exact same public graph, no predictor may receive world label or source family
source.positive_negative_pair_histogram_matched: complete original public query/role/edge topology and full src/dst bit-token histogram; mask the target/donor pair identically before swapping

model.name: FIT-learned abstention head on engineered public identifiability features
model.input: candidate public error masks, graph-derived possible positive and possible negative path support, number of masked source lanes; strong engineered features explicitly acknowledged
model.fixed_control: deterministic sound three-way identifiability: positive if all compatible latent completions permit only valid causal path, negative if none, ABSTAIN if both; never oracle or label
model.trained_head: three-way softmax linear weight matrix 3x4 engineered features plus three biases =15 FIT learned coefficients, one threshold confidence used only for added abstentions =16 total model params

training.selection: zero false positives, zero false negatives on resolved positives/negatives, zero forced decisions on ambiguous public observations, >=72 of 144 per-category resolved FIT coverage (per total 144/144 positive and 144/144 negative across 3 families); else unqualified and fixed diagnostic threshold 0.95

model.ablation: untrained same feature head and same threshold, vs strong fixed identifiability control; operator-induced features are NOT learned
